test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 14 Sept 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word in the given sentence.

Shiya had more __grit__ than her other siblings.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"grit"** means firmness of mind or spirit; unyielding courage in the face of hardship or danger. (दृढ़ता)

 
 
• **Example: **She showed **grit** by continuing her studies despite the financial difficulties.
 
 
 
• **"Courage"** refers to the ability to do something that frightens one; bravery. (साहस)
 
 
• **Example: **He demonstrated great** courage **by standing up to the bully.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **courage**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Power** (शक्ति): The ability or capacity to do something or act in a particular way.

 
 
• **Example:** He has the **power** to influence decisions in the company.
 
 
 
• **Level** (स्तर): A specific height or line, especially one at which something is situated or occurs.
 
 
• **Example: **Her skill **level** in chess is quite advanced.
 
 
 
• **Gap** (अंतराल): A break or hole in an object or between two objects.
 
 
• **Example:** There is a **gap** in the fence where the dog escaped.
